subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT abiotic?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Plant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Biotic Factor:__

 __
 
• The word ‘biotic’ refers to having to do with living organisms.
 
• They refer to the biological component of the ecosystem, consisting of a population of plants, animals and micro-organisms in complex communities.
 
• The biotic factors influencing an organism, viruses and other parasitic organisms cause diseases.
 
• These are all parts of an organism’s biotic environment.
 
• The biotic component consists of three distinct groups of organisms, producers, consumers and decomposers.
 
• Examples of biotic factors are fungi, bacteria, yeast, etc.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Abiotic Factor:

 
 
• Factors other than the biotic factors which are important for the atmosphere are called abiotic factors.
 
• Other physical factors include climate, temperature, precipitation, types of soil present (sandy or clay, dry or wet, fertile or infertile), and wind.
 
• In the ecosystem, the abiotic (non-living) components perform the important function of providing water and oxygen for organisms.
